items.name: dissolve-kit
items.title: dissolve-kit
items.description: Shared helpers of the dissolve web components: easing, springs, DOM and canvas helpers.

items.name: dissolve-engine
items.title: dissolve-engine
items.description: The dissolve grain engine for the web (Canvas 2D).

items.name: dissolve-react
items.title: dissolve-react
items.description: The hook that mounts a dissolve core in React.

items.name: dissolve-gl
items.title: dissolve-gl
items.description: WebGL2 helper for the dissolve shaders.

items.name: dissolve-theme
items.title: dissolve theme
items.description: The --dissolve-* tokens, light and dark.

items.name: swipe-to-delete
items.title: SwipeToDelete
items.description: Swipe a row left to delete it: it dissolves, then the list closes up.

items.name: toast
items.title: ToastProvider, useToast
items.description: Toasts that arrive in grains and leave as dust, with an optional Undo action.

items.name: like-button
items.title: LikeButton
items.description: Heart that pops with sparks on like and snaps into grains on unlike.

items.name: morph-button
items.title: MorphButton
items.description: Dynamic Island style pill that folds into a loader, then opens as the done state.

items.name: split-button
items.title: SplitButton
items.description: Splits in two like a drop of liquid metal, Cancel and Confirm halves.

items.name: slide-to-confirm
items.title: SlideToConfirm
items.description: Slide to pay or confirm, shimmer label, loader, done state.

items.name: gooey-menu
items.title: GooeyMenu
items.description: Floating button whose actions pour out as gooey drops.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTPInput
items.description: One time code boxes, verify sweep, success tint, shake and dust on reject.

items.name: number-ticker
items.title: NumberTicker
items.description: Rolling digit columns for prices and counters, locale aware.

items.name: reaction-picker
items.title: ReactionPicker
items.description: iMessage style reactions: long press, dock magnifier, emoji flies to a badge.

items.name: voice-note
items.title: VoiceNote
items.description: Voice message bubble: play, scrub the waveform with ticks, unsend as dust.

items.name: card-stack
items.title: CardStack
items.description: Wallet style card stack: tap to focus, drag down to put back, swipe to cycle.

items.name: signature-pad
items.title: SignaturePad
items.description: Variable width Skia signature, undo, clear into dust, PNG export.

items.name: before-after
items.title: BeforeAfter
items.description: Before / after image comparison with a draggable divider and haptic ticks.

items.name: thinking-orb
items.title: ThinkingOrb
items.description: A sphere of dots that shows what an AI agent is doing: thinking, searching, listening, done.

items.name: image-reveal
items.title: ImageReveal
items.description: Image generation loader: a thinking mosaic that resolves coarse to fine, then settles in grains.

items.name: sweep-transition
items.title: SweepTransition
items.description: A crisp liquid band sweeps across a view and leaves the new state behind it.

items.name: upload-tile
items.title: UploadTile, UploadTray
items.description: Attachment that assembles from grains, fills a progress ring, rejected files leave as dust.

items.name: task-check
items.title: TaskCheck
items.description: Checkbox that draws its check and strikes the label, then the task moves away or dissolves.

items.name: quantity-stepper
items.title: QuantityStepper
items.description: Minus and plus with rolling digits and an accelerating long press; at 1 it turns into a trash.

items.name: ruler-picker
items.title: RulerPicker
items.description: Horizontal ruler with momentum, rolling value and a haptic tick per graduation.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: BarChart
items.description: Bar chart you scrub with a finger, sliding bubble, bars regrow on period change.

items.name: mini-player
items.title: MiniPlayer
items.description: Now playing pill that opens into a full player as one object, then folds back.

items.name: pull-to-refresh
items.title: PullToRefresh
items.description: Pull a list down: grains gather into a loader, release and the content rebuilds itself.

items.name: reorder-list
items.title: ReorderList
items.description: Long press a row to lift it, drag to reorder, the others make room, it settles with a tick.

items.name: glossy-button
items.title: GlossyButton
items.description: Tactile pill lit from the inside: gradient stroke, inner light and ring, presses down on a crisp spring.

items.name: scratch-card
items.title: ScratchCard
items.description: Glossy foil scratch card that tilts in 3D under the finger, sheds grains, then dissolves past the threshold.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton, SkeletonBlock
items.description: Loading placeholders that break into grains and recompose into the real content, block by block.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: SegmentedControl
items.description: iOS segmented control whose pill breaks into grains, flows to the new segment and reassembles. Drag across to follow the finger.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: iOS switch whose thumb breaks into grains, flows to the other end of the track and reassembles while the track fills.

items.name: progress-steps
items.title: ProgressSteps
items.description: Numbered steps on a line, or story style bars: the progress streams on to the next step in grains.

items.name: elastic-slider
items.title: ElasticSlider
items.description: Thick rounded slider whose texts invert over the fill; pulled past an end, the track stretches like a rubber band and snaps back.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Expandable sections: the height glides open, the chevron turns over and the content slides in.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: CopyButton
items.description: Icon button that copies text: the copy icon breaks into grains that reform as a check, a Copied tooltip rises.
